title: Minimal k-covering
statementMd:
You are given a bipartite graph $*G* = (*U*, *V*, *E*)$, $*U*$ is the set of vertices of the first part, $*V*$ is the set of vertices of the second part and $*E*$ is the set of edges. There might be multiple edges.

Let's call some subset of its edges ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e6fd4de7a5e51fb9e41d0da53a126fb1fa5b5816.png) *$*k*$-covering* iff the graph ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3d5f96647be417c8f189d1da2f2152840412ac15.png) has each of its vertices incident to at least $*k*$ edges. *Minimal $*k*$-covering* is such a $*k*$-covering that the size of the subset ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e6fd4de7a5e51fb9e41d0da53a126fb1fa5b5816.png) is minimal possible.

Your task is to find minimal $*k*$-covering for each ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/36b710172cf0e7b4b9dc703e0dd4b4834e24f054.png), where $*minDegree*$ is the minimal degree of any vertex in graph $*G*$.

## Input

The first line contains three integers $*n*_{1}$, $*n*_{2}$ and $*m*$ ($1 ≤ *n*_{1}, *n*_{2} ≤ 2000$, $0 ≤ *m* ≤ 2000$) — the number of vertices in the first part, the number of vertices in the second part and the number of edges, respectively.

The $*i*$-th of the next $*m*$ lines contain two integers $*u*_{*i*}$ and $*v*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *u*_{*i*} ≤ *n*_{1}, 1 ≤ *v*_{*i*} ≤ *n*_{2}$) — the description of the $*i*$-th edge, $*u*_{*i*}$ is the index of the vertex in the first part and $*v*_{*i*}$ is the index of the vertex in the second part.

## Output

For each ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/36b710172cf0e7b4b9dc703e0dd4b4834e24f054.png) print the subset of edges (minimal $*k*$-covering) in separate line.

The first integer $*cnt*_{*k*}$ of the $*k*$-th line is the number of edges in minimal $*k*$-covering of the graph. Then $*cnt*_{*k*}$ integers follow — original indices of the edges which belong to the minimal $*k*$-covering, these indices should be pairwise distinct. Edges are numbered $1$ through $*m*$ in order they are given in the input.
statementZhMd:
你得到了一个二分图 $*G* = (*U*, *V*, *E*)$，其中 $*U*$ 是第一部分的顶点集合，$*V*$ 是第二部分的顶点集合，$*E*$ 是边集合。图中可能存在重边。

如果某个边的子集 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e6fd4de7a5e51fb9e41d0da53a126fb1fa5b5816.png) 是一个 *$*k*$-覆盖*，则由这些边构成的图 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/3d5f96647be417c8f189d1da2f2152840412ac15.png) 中的每个顶点都至少关联 $*k*$ 条边。*最小 $*k*$-覆盖* 是指大小尽可能小的 $*k*$-覆盖。

你的任务是对于每个 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/36b710172cf0e7b4b9dc703e0dd4b4834e24f054.png) 找到最小 $*k*$-覆盖，其中 $*minDegree*$ 是图 $*G*$ 中任意顶点的最小度数。

## 输入格式

第一行包含三个整数 $*n*_{1}$、$*n*_{2}$ 和 $*m*$（$1 ≤ *n*_{1}, *n*_{2} ≤ 2000$，$0 ≤ *m* ≤ 2000$），分别表示第一部分的顶点数、第二部分的顶点数和边数。

接下来的 $*m*$ 行中，第 $*i*$ 行包含两个整数 $*u*_{*i}$ 和 $*v*_{*i}$（$1 ≤ *u*_{*i} ≤ *n*_{1}$，$1 ≤ *v*_{*i} ≤ *n*_{2}$），表示第 $*i*$ 条边，其中 $*u*_{*i}$ 是第一部分中顶点的编号，$*v*_{*i}$ 是第二部分中顶点的编号。

## 输出格式

对于每个 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/36b710172cf0e7b4b9dc703e0dd4b4834e24f054.png)，在单独一行中输出边的子集（即最小 $*k*$-覆盖）。

第 $*k*$ 行的第一个整数 $*cnt*_{*k*$} 表示图的最小 $*k*$-覆盖中的边数。接下来输出 $*cnt*_{*k*$} 个整数，表示属于该最小 $*k*$-覆盖的边的原始编号；这些编号必须两两不同。边按照输入中的顺序编号为 $1$ 到 $*m*$。
